_purpose: Documents how the Indonesian/Balinese/Cirebonese synthetic QA-translation corpus is generated, so the raw intermediate batch/generation artifacts (OpenAI Batch API files, per-topic JSONL shards) don't have to be kept indefinitely just to answer 'what model/prompt made this'. See REMOVED_ARTIFACTS.json for what was deleted after this file was written.
_layout_note: As of 2026-09-01 this manifest and everything it describes (seeds, raw per-topic shards) live under synthetic_data/ at the repo root -- see the paths below. synthetic_data/raw/ and synthetic_data/seeds/generated_topics.json are gitignored (bulk data); this file and synthetic_data/seeds/seed_topics_first_1000.txt are tracked.

splits.filtered_heuristic: LID-filtered subset of raw, rebuilt by refresh_filtered_subset.py

pipeline.system_prompt: You are an assistant who always responds in fluent, natural Indonesian. Deliver only the final answer; never describe internal reasoning or thought processes. Reduce the use of bullet points, numbered lists, headings, or any list-like formatting; only use it when really necessary. Vary sentence length and tone to keep the prose engaging, weaving in relevant examples, comparisons, or brief illustrative anecdotes when helpful. Do not repeat or rephrase the question; begin directly with the answer in Indonesian language.
pipeline.output: synthetic_data/raw/answers/topic<NNNN>.jsonl (one file per topic, ~900 Q&A pairs each)
pipeline.note: Topics answered before 2025-11-11 (commit 8d6c641) were generated via the OpenAI Batch API (model gpt-5-nano) instead of vLLM. Those runs' raw batch files lived in batches/results + batches/errors and were deleted 2026-09-01 (see REMOVED_ARTIFACTS.json) once verified 100% redundant with the synthetic_data/raw/answers/ shards they produced -- the vLLM script always re-wrote the same custom_ids into that directory in the live per-topic format.

pipeline.script: python -m scaleres.generation.translate_answers (or run via scaleres.generation.run_translate_chunks for bounded batches)
pipeline.system_prompt: You are a precise translation assistant. Follow every user instruction carefully. Never describe internal reasoning or thought processes. Always reply only with a single valid JSON object containing exactly two string keys: "balinese" and "cirebonese". Never add commentary, code fences, or extra text.
pipeline.prompt_template: synthetic_data/instruction.txt (translation instructions + <text> wrapper; lexicon hints appended per-request)

pipeline.filters_applied: optional --balinese-clean/--cirebonese-clean id allowlists from metrics/cache/{lang}/translations_clean.jsonl (produced by scaleres.dataprep.clean_translations)
pipeline.dedup: by id, drops rows with any empty indonesian/balinese/cirebonese field

pipeline.method: GlotLID language-identification pass (models/glotlid/model.bin) per language, keeps rows where both balinese and cirebonese pass

known_live_downstream_consumer.note: Not produced by any script in this repo's history -- built ad hoc (Aug 2026) from synthetic_gen_parallel_subsets for the autoresearch/ SAE-gap research program, which reads it from ~15 experiment scripts. Do not delete or rebuild without checking autoresearch/ first.
